profile.headline: LLM Technical Lead for Internal Research & Development at Intuitive Research and Technology Corporation
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer and Internal Research and development Technical Lead, I bring a unique blend of expertise in large language models (LLMs) and advanced Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. With a solid foundation in Computer Engineering and an ongoing pursuit of a Master's in Data Science, I thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical application.

At Intuitive Research & Technology Corporation, I oversee innovative LLM initiatives, including designing and developing a web application leveraging transformers and advanced RAG techniques. My work is rooted in a deep understanding of AI/ML systems, as demonstrated by my role as the lead author on a top 20 paper at I/ITSEC 2024, focusing on LLM security considerations and the potential for unintentional data leakage.

In addition to my work in LLMs, I’ve played a key role in modernizing submarine vulnerability assessment software, collaborating closely with NSWC Carderock. My contributions include designing a robust Entity Component System (ECS) architecture for Submarines and designing and implementing advanced procedural generation algorithms utilizing the ECS to render 3D models for vulnerability and lethality assessments.

Beyond my technical roles, I am a committed lifelong learner passionate about exploring how technology can solve real-world problems. My journey is fueled by curiosity, innovation, and a dedication to excellence. When I'm not immersed in the expansive world of LLMs, I'm a husband, father, and technology enthusiast.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
FlatSat
• Led technical deep-dives into NASA’s cFS framework, authoring comprehensive technical specifications and onboarding documentation that reduced developer ramp-up time for the engineering team.
• Architected and implemented a standardized CMake build system, ensuring cross-platform compatibility and streamlining the compilation process.

Internal Research and Development
• Led the full-stack development of an enterprise-grade AI application, ensuring seamless API integration and maintaining high upstream compatibility for continuous integration workflows.
• Architected scalable data ingestion pipelines and managed vector databases to optimize semantic search and RAG performance.
• Designed a comprehensive observability stack to monitor distributed telemetry, logs, and performance metrics for large-scale AI models and distributed systems.
• Directed research on LLM security vulnerabilities, designing and executing controlled validation experiments; served as lead author for a paper recognized as a "Top 5 Paper" at the I/ITSEC 2024 conference.
• Led technical feasibility assessments for LLM-driven digital transformation initiatives, providing architectural recommendations aligned with strategic business objectives.
• Applied advanced statistical and signal-processing techniques to extract actionable insights from complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Submarine Vulnerability Assessment and Lethality Evaluation
• Spearheaded the modernization of mission-critical submarine vulnerability assessment software in partnership with NSWC Carderock, significantly improving system capabilities and accuracy.
• Architected a high-performance Entity Component System (ECS) to drive the procedural generation of complex 3D models, leveraging advanced algorithms to enhance simulation fidelity.
• Developed and validated advanced mathematical models for damage assessment, working directly with stakeholders to ensure high-precision calculations for real-world application.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Computer Science and +47 skills

positions.title: Patriot Verification & Validation Analyst
positions.description:
• Conducted extensive testing and analysis of Patriot maintenance software, identifying and reporting over 70 issues to support quality control efforts.
• Collaborated with prime contractor developers to ensure successful execution of all software development life cycle stages, from planning to deployment.
• Streamlined reporting processes by implementing a standardized structure, reducing the time required to document identified issues and improving team efficiency.
• Utilized Python scripting expertise to deliver cross‑team support, significantly enhancing project outcomes and ensuring overall success.
